title: Soundness of the split search
statement: For natural numbers $C,c,m,n$, if the exponential split search at length $m$ returns $n$, then $n\le m$ and $n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}=m$.
hypotheses_covered: The split search at length $m$ returns $n$
replaced: For natural numbers $C, c, m, n$: if the exponential split search at length $m$ returns $n$, then $n \le m$ and $n + C \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} = m$.
